description: Send Swell email notifications through Resend
name: Resend

images.title: Connect your Resend account
images.description: Add your API key and a sender address on your verified domain, then switch notifications over one at a time.

images.title: Choose the emails Resend sends
images.description: Order, refund, customer and subscription emails, each with its own switch. Turn on only the ones you want Resend to send.

images.title: Route your own templates
images.description: Pick a supported event and name one of your own notification templates. No code changes needed.
